Our Story

Rooted in Chiang Mai. Inspired by the North.

Born in Chiang Mai and shaped by the landscapes, traditions, and quiet beauty of Northern Thailand, we create thoughtfully curated journeys that reveal the North beyond the familiar — guided by local knowledge, genuine hospitality, and a slower, more considered way of travelling.

Privacy & Data Sanctuary

1. Sanctuary of Personal Confidentiality

Your personal details, contact coordinates, travel dates, and companion information are preserved with strict discretion. We never share, trade, or distribute guest data to outside marketing parties.

2. Direct Communication Guarantee

Details submitted via our contact forms or direct WhatsApp channels are exclusively utilized to tailor your itinerary and facilitate your journey in Chiang Mai, Chiang Rai, and Mae Hong Son.

3. Right to Erasure

At any point following your expedition, you may request full erasure of your travel records from our concierge systems with immediate effect.
